why.gate1: UNEVALUABLE - FROZEN CHALLENGE PHENOTYPE NOT REPRODUCED UNDER V2
why.measured_cause: key re-domaining; first 20 forward draws for rep9/14/17 are 20 drops under InitialSource and all-good under V2Forward, i.e. absent from draw 0 before any interleaving
why.key_not_changed: both keys conform to C2 clause 5, so the choice may not be made on outcome grounds

selection: run OFF arm only over the whole universe; ON arm not built, run or read
collect qualifying seeds in ascending repetition order
take the first 3 as the challenge set (deterministic, lexicographic-by-index)
take the next 3 as a disjoint confirmation set
write both lists to the ledger and HASH them before any ON arm runs
if fewer than 3 qualify: do NOT widen, weaken or re-domain; report CHANNEL-MODEL-PROPERTY / DEFAULT PROMOTION BLOCKED and apply C1

gates_unchanged.empty_pass_rule: a gate the OFF arm already meets is MECHANISM-UNEVALUABLE (NON-HARM ONLY), not PASS

prohibited: widening the universe after seeing counts
changing the seed domain to obtain stalls

A2_window_sensitivity.mismatch_remedy: a NEW preregistration with a corrected window - NOT enlarging this universe

A3_confirmation_is_holdout: both lists hashed before any ON arm runs
confirmation not opened until challenge is 3/3
product fixes allowed against challenge; each fix requires challenge 3/3 again
confirmation opens ONCE, after challenge 3/3 and the final product commit is frozen
default promotion requires confirmation 3/3 as well
if the product changes after the confirmation result is seen, that set is no longer a holdout and may not be reused for a PASS
confirmation failure BLOCKS M2 and requires §4 lineage / C1

A4_selection_enrichment.replacement_has_same_property: three seeds chosen from 512 are by definition worst cases
A4_selection_enrichment.binding: 3/3 recovered is MECHANISM evidence, NOT PREVALENCE evidence
A4_selection_enrichment.phrasing: the mechanism recovers the selected stall phenotype - NOT cold start is solved
